title: Block Out Level 29 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 29 is a twin-boss spine board. Strip the center red-black-white ladder first, lower the side boss columns second, and only then rotate the late red, yellow, blue, and green maze pieces.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 29 is a twin-boss spine board. Strip the center red-black-white ladder first, lower the side boss columns second, and only then rotate the late red, yellow, blue, and green maze pieces.
landmarks: Block Out Level 29 is a twin-boss spine board.
Strip the center red-black-white ladder first, lower the side boss columns second, and only then rotate the late red, yellow, blue, and green maze pieces.
The board mixes Red, Black, White and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The center spine is phase one.
The late maze only matters after both sides have started opening.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Strip the center red-black-white spine so both side bosses start losing support together.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Keep the side columns mostly parked while the shared counters are still high.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Lower the left and right framed bosses only after the center lane is clearly thinner.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: When the bosses open, rotate the late red, yellow, blue, and green maze pieces into the new pockets.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Keep the top counters falling while the center is no longer a wall.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Use the late green shapes to stop the side lanes from refilling.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish the maze after both side bosses have already collapsed.

failurePoints: Trying to solve one side boss before the center spine has opened.
Ignoring the late maze structure after the side columns start to fall.
